pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Irregular polygonal dark regions with rounded vertices on the mid-flank, transitioning to more angular, geometric shapes on the lower neck. Edge gradients appear relatively smooth at the current resolution. Relative spatial area of patches is high compared to the separating corridors.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Continuous network of light-colored pathways. Junction nodes primarily exhibit tri-radial and quadri-radial configurations. Pathway thickness is relatively uniform across the mid-section with high topological continuity.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Low-amplitude, high-frequency serrated silhouette visible along the dorsal neck line, characteristic of a short, upright mane.
